title: Electrical Power System Hod Profile
meta_description: HOD PROFILE Dr.S.Sravan Kumar, B.Tech, M.Tech,Ph.D is a Associate Professor and Head of the M.Tech(EPS),He has completed Ph.D in Electrical Power Systems from JJT university,Rajasthan, Master Degree in Power Electronics and Electric Drives from KMIC&S,Hyderabad,and Bachelor’s degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from SVEC Engineering College. He has total of 12 years experience in teaching.
paragraphs: Dr.S.Sravan Kumar, B.Tech, M.Tech,Ph.D is a Associate Professor and Head of the M.Tech(EPS),He has completed Ph.D in Electrical Power Systems from JJT university,Rajasthan, Master Degree in Power Electronics and Electric Drives from KMIC&S,Hyderabad,and Bachelor’s degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from SVEC Engineering College. He has total of 12 years experience in teaching. and has produced several research publications in both national and international journals.
